Australian and New Zealand internet users are being warned about a rise in scam gambling websites, with Infoblox flagging significant malicious traffic targeting the ANZ region. Separately, Microsoft has issued emergency patches following this month's large Patch Tuesday update — meaning organisations should check that Windows systems are fully up to date as soon as possible, as these fixes address actively exploited vulnerabilities.

On the local tech front, Secure Code Warrior has launched an AI literacy training programme aimed at helping everyday staff work more safely with AI tools — a timely reminder that security awareness extends beyond IT teams.

**Practical tip:** Check that automatic Windows updates are enabled on all staff devices today to ensure the latest Microsoft emergency fixes are applied.
